searchTerms: Salvatore Cognetti, died 9 Sep 1938, Scranton, Lackawanna Co., certificate file 80521
whatTheSnippetShows: PA death index 1938 (C-D volume, PDF p. 29, Soundex C253): SALVATORE COGNETTI, SCRANTON, county 35, 9/9/38, file 80521 (no age in this index)
whyItMatters: Not Frank's son Sal (alive 1940-1990). A Salvatore Cognetti dying in Scranton in 1938 could be a brother, uncle or father of Frank (Giovanni reportedly died 1930 in 'Nicasetro') or belong to the Nicastro Cognetti family; the certificate names parents and birthplace.
